description: This file declares the RuntimeManagerImplementation class, which implements runtime management, configuration, and event handling interfaces for a plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies related to runtime container management, notifications, and event processing.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements runtime management, configuration, and event handling for containerized applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. Manages container lifecycle events, notifications, and internal state.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class used internally to handle runtime events asynchronously, encapsulating event type and parameters.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for runtime events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts a runtime container with specified application parameters.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes up the specified application instance with a given runtime state.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Forcefully kills the specified application instance.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific application instance.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds metadata to an application instance.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts necessary resources for runtime management.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts resources used for runtime management.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the runtime manager with the provided service.
